blocks.x: What Patient Priority Portal — Architecture & Trust means at Achala IT Solutions: the scope we sign, the architecture we ship, the evidence generated in-flight, and the per workflow outcomes measured against your audited baseline.

The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (permissioned DLT with bank-grade operations, membership, visibility zones, legal wrapper, compliance-aware issuance and transfer controls); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (specification-first, verified, audited contracts, custody anchoring with role-based verification); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.

blocks.title: Patient Priority Portal — plane and service layers
blocks.note: The layering is what makes the estate auditable: any claim can be traced down through the contracts that carry it.

blocks.title: Patient Priority Portal — deployment topology and flow
blocks.note: Edge nodes ship with the same controls as the core — identity, monitoring and rollback — because a branch office is not a demilitarized zone.

blocks.x: Ledger networks ship key management under HSM custody, timelocked upgrade governance, and immutable audit exports. Smart contracts carry specification, verification and independent audit before value moves; pause procedures are rehearsed, not improvised.
